_comment: Postgres extensions Pyo's databases offer (the Extensions tab). 'managed': turned on and off by Pyo, as superuser through CloudNativePG (preload: libraries in shared_preload_libraries, a restart; parameters: {database} and {owner} filled in; library: the one CloudNativePG preloads for the parameters; create: CREATE EXTENSION; requires: created with it; schemaOwner: that schema's owner becomes the database owner; fdw: the owner may use its foreign-data wrapper; edition: shown beside its name). TimescaleDB is the Apache 2 build: its background jobs (and so every policy) need the Timescale license, so its workers are off; otherwise its built-in job history job fails on every run.. 'additional': the database owner (the default role) creates these itself. Only what Pyo's Postgres image has (deploy/images/postgres.Dockerfile), checked against pg_available_extensions and its trusted and superuser flags. hidden: obsolete (Postgres says so), listed only while a database has it on.

extensions.name: auto_explain
extensions.description: Logs the plan of every query that takes over a second.

extensions.name: pg_cron
extensions.description: Runs SQL on a schedule, with cron syntax, inside the database.

extensions.name: pg_hint_plan
extensions.description: Steers the query planner with hints in SQL comments.

extensions.name: pg_partman_bgw
extensions.description: Runs pg_partman's partition maintenance every hour. Add pg_partman itself with the default role.

extensions.name: pg_stat_statements
extensions.description: Tracks planning and execution statistics of every query.

extensions.name: pgaudit
extensions.description: Writes an audit trail of schema and role changes to the logs.

extensions.name: timescaledb
extensions.description: Hypertables and time functions for time series, without compression, continuous aggregates or scheduled jobs.

extensions.name: vector
extensions.description: Vector similarity search: embeddings and nearest neighbours (pgvector).

extensions.name: autoinc
extensions.description: Trigger function that fills a field from a sequence.

extensions.name: bloom
extensions.description: Index type based on Bloom filters, for many columns at once.

extensions.name: dblink
extensions.description: Runs queries on other Postgres databases from inside this one.

extensions.name: dict_xsyn
extensions.description: Text search dictionary that adds synonyms to words.

extensions.name: earthdistance
extensions.description: Great-circle distances between points on the Earth.

extensions.name: insert_username
extensions.description: Trigger function that records who changed a row.

extensions.name: intagg
extensions.description: Integer aggregator and enumerator (obsolete).

extensions.name: moddatetime
extensions.description: Trigger function that records when a row changed.

extensions.name: pg_prewarm
extensions.description: Loads tables into memory, so the first queries after a restart are fast.

extensions.name: pgrowlocks
extensions.description: Shows which rows of a table are locked, and by whom.

extensions.name: postgres_fdw
extensions.description: Queries tables on other Postgres servers as if they were local.

extensions.name: refint
extensions.description: Trigger functions for referential integrity (obsolete).

extensions.name: sslinfo
extensions.description: Details of the client's SSL certificate.

extensions.name: xml2
extensions.description: XPath queries and XSLT on XML.

extensions.name: btree_gin
extensions.description: GIN index support for common data types.

extensions.name: btree_gist
extensions.description: GiST index support for common data types.

extensions.name: citext
extensions.description: Case-insensitive text type.

extensions.name: cube
extensions.description: Type for multidimensional cubes.

extensions.name: dict_int
extensions.description: Text search dictionary for integers.

extensions.name: fuzzystrmatch
extensions.description: Similarity and distance between strings: Soundex, Levenshtein, Metaphone.

extensions.name: hstore
extensions.description: Type for sets of key and value pairs.

extensions.name: intarray
extensions.description: Functions, operators and indexes for arrays of integers.

extensions.name: isn
extensions.description: Types for product numbers: ISBN, ISMN, ISSN, EAN13, UPC.

extensions.name: lo
extensions.description: Managing large objects.

extensions.name: ltree
extensions.description: Type for tree-like labels, such as categories.

extensions.name: pg_partman
extensions.description: Creates and maintains partitions of tables by time or ID.

extensions.name: pg_trgm
extensions.description: Text similarity and fast LIKE and ILIKE searches with trigrams.

extensions.name: pgcrypto
extensions.description: Hashing and encryption functions.

extensions.name: seg
extensions.description: Type for line segments and floating-point intervals.

extensions.name: tablefunc
extensions.description: Functions that return tables, such as crosstab.

extensions.name: tcn
extensions.description: Trigger function that sends notifications of table changes.

extensions.name: tsm_system_rows
extensions.description: TABLESAMPLE method that takes a number of rows.

extensions.name: tsm_system_time
extensions.description: TABLESAMPLE method that takes a time limit.

extensions.name: unaccent
extensions.description: Text search dictionary that removes accents.

extensions.name: uuid-ossp
extensions.description: Functions that generate UUIDs.

_kvComment: KV (Valkey) modules Pyo's KV databases offer, all from the valkey-bundle image (PYO_DB_VALKEY_BUNDLE_IMAGE, Valkey 8.1): module is the file loaded with loadmodule on every instance (in this order), loaded the name MODULE LIST reports, dataInfo the INFO field counting what it holds (data): Valkey can't start without a module whose data it has, so one stays loaded until that's deleted. Turning one on or off restarts the database (replicas first, then the primary hands over). All BSD-3-Clause.

kv.name: valkey-json
kv.description: Stores JSON documents and reads or changes them by path (JSON.SET, JSON.GET).

kv.name: valkey-bloom
kv.description: Bloom filters: whether an item was seen before, in little memory (BF.ADD, BF.EXISTS).

kv.name: valkey-search
kv.description: Vector similarity search over hashes and JSON documents (FT.CREATE, FT.SEARCH).
